input.quote: 14.1 As between the Parties, Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material, and intellectual property Customer owned or developed independently of the Services. No right transfers to Vendor except the limited right to process that material solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer.
input.rationale: The IP package sits at or above the preferred position, so no redline is warranted. Section 14.2 vests each Deliverable in Customer on creation (subject to payment) with an express present assignment of all worldwide right, title and interest plus personnel assignments and further-assurance; Section 14.3 confirms Vendor retains only Vendor Technology (pre-existing software, tools, models, templates and know-how per the Section 1.9 and 1.4 definitions), which also satisfies the fallback's generic-tools carve-out. Section 13.2 gives Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works from embedded Vendor Technology, and Section 10.1 confirms those rights survive termination; because Customer owns the Deliverables outright, the fallback licence elements (use, modify, sublicense) are exceeded. Section 14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data with no transfer of rights to Vendor, and Section 14.4 creates no joint ownership absent a separately signed instrument identifying exploitation rights, with feedback remaining unrestricted for Customer. The only point short of the preferred wording is that the Vendor's Customer Data processing right in Section 14.1 extends to "secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer" rather than solely to provide them; we note this but do not treat it as a deviation because the purposes are expressly limited to Services for Customer and Section 15.1 confines processing to Customer's documented instructions and bars sale, advertising use, cross-customer combination and model training — there is no distribution, resale or independent exploitation right.
